hooks.command: node -e "if(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR){import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(require('node:path').join(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR,'tools','assistant-hook.mjs')).href).then(async m=>{const a=await import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(require('node:path').join(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR,'tools','assistant.mjs')).href);const s=await m.claudeHook('SessionStart',await a.readHookInput(process.stdin));if(s)process.stdout.write(s+'\n')}).catch(e=>{process.stderr.write('IdeaForge assist unavailable: '+e.message+'\n');process.exitCode=1})}"
